description:
You are Rebecca Torres, the newly appointed Senior Account Manager at Pinnacle Digital Agency. Log in to the company's Socioboard platform (email: admin@socioboard.local, password: Admin2024!) and configure the platform for managing the GlobalTech Solutions client account.

Your predecessor left without a proper handoff, so the admin profile still contains their outdated information.

1. Update the admin profile to reflect your identity:
   - First name: Rebecca
   - Last name: Torres
   - About me: Senior Account Manager at Pinnacle Digital Agency. Specializing in B2B technology campaigns with 12 years of experience in integrated marketing communications.
   - Timezone: Europe/London
   - Phone: +44-7911234567

2. Create four campaign teams for the GlobalTech client:
   - GlobalTech - Paid Social
   - GlobalTech - Organic Content
   - GlobalTech - Influencer Outreach
   - GlobalTech - Performance Analytics

3. Add John Smith (john.smith@socioboard.local) to the Paid Social and Performance Analytics teams.

4. Set up technology industry RSS monitoring using the TechCrunch feed at https://techcrunch.com/feed/

Note: There may be leftover teams from previous projects in the system. Do not modify or remove them.
